name: zap-plate
effect: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Electric moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Electric.
short_effect: Held: Electric-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceus’s and Judgment’s type to Electric.

flavor_text.x-y: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a stone tablet that boosts the power of Electric-type moves.
